_comment: Kansas 2026 QAP thresholds: Section V Threshold Eligibility (pp.14-23) and the Appendix A Article 10 categories (p.48). The seven Appendix A categories sum to the stated 310 (50 + 45 + 80 + 10 + 75 + 5 + 45), and each is all-or-nothing. Omitted from Section V: V.A.2 (a definition of Principals), V.A.4, V.A.8 and V.A.12 (general contractor cost certification, the minimum set-aside election and the order for offering accessible units, all procedural), V.B.1 and V.B.5, and V.C.6, whose substance sits in scored criterion VII.K.4. The Section VIII underwriting standards are not itemised.
